# Vendored files

`sdled.wasm` is the SidePulse firmware's LEDS.LED interpreter compiled to WebAssembly, copied from the `sidepulse` Python package (version 0.2.4.dev39, `sidepulse/resources/sdled.wasm`) published at https://github.com/inteliwear/sidepulse under the MIT license in `LICENSE-sidepulse`.
